items.html:
Reginald Nehonde is a right-hand batsman and offspinner who is part of the Zimbabwe squad to the 2008 Under-19 World Cup in Malaysia. He started playing the game at the age of 11, and has played for Zimbabwe U-14s and U-16s. A fan of Ricky Ponting, he is also interested in becoming a sociologist.
Cricinfo Staff February 2008
